failure_modes.mode: Bulk imports overwrite sources or one invalid file aborts the batch
failure_modes.cause: Unvalidated file conversion and name collisions
failure_modes.mitigation: Per-file outcomes, bounded parsing, collision-safe new variants, source revision history and explicit default selection

failure_modes.mode: Edited writing draft is treated as approved or sent to another workspace
failure_modes.mitigation: Workspace-scoped versioned drafts, validation before explicit publication and preserved prior approved documents

failure_modes.mode: Profile or portfolio UI drops unedited fields
failure_modes.cause: Replacement payloads or incomplete structured editors
failure_modes.mitigation: Partial merges, structured project editors and visible source-input revisions

failure_modes.mode: Scope expands to archived or unselected jobs
failure_modes.mitigation: Central eligibility plus validated explicit job scope; submission remains separate

failure_modes.mode: Run hangs or drops late work
failure_modes.mitigation: Active upstream graph, bounded backoff, terminal stalled/cancelled states
Lossless edits, route provenance, content hashes, explicit ambiguity override, preserved document history

failure_modes.mode: Custom source leaks between workspaces or reaches local infrastructure
failure_modes.cause: Global mutable catalog or unrestricted URL
failure_modes.detection: Workspace isolation and URL validation tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Workspace-owned registry and public HTTP(S) source validation

failure_modes.mode: Provider outage consumes unlimited budget or masks failure
failure_modes.mitigation: Retryable score states, capped attempts, explicit second-opinion budget, measured usage and structured outcomes
